compare.definition: Descriptively contrast comparable observations of one numerical measure.
compare.selection: Comparison goal; insufficient specificity is preserved rather than forced into a child.

compare.groups.definition: Compare a numerical measure across specified groups.
compare.groups.selection: At least two groups and a measure; a time filter alone does not imply trajectories.

compare.groups.trajectories.definition: Compare temporal change of the same measure across groups.
compare.groups.trajectories.selection: Explicit temporal change or trajectory comparison across groups, with resolvable time points and grain.

compare.time.definition: Compare one subject across explicit time points.
compare.time.selection: One subject and a measure, explicitly contrasted across time.

measure_semantics.definition: Requested concept matches the bound measure, supported by semantic evidence.
measure_semantics.evidence_contract: Bound profile claims with provenance, inspection completeness and scope. Missing evidence is unknown.

observation_binding.definition: All supplied roles refer to the same logical observation relation and measure.
observation_binding.evidence_contract: Bound profile claims with provenance, inspection completeness and scope. Missing evidence is unknown.

group_coverage.definition: Every requested group occurs in the bound relation within requested context.
group_coverage.evidence_contract: Bound profile claims with provenance, inspection completeness and scope. Missing evidence is unknown.

time_coverage.definition: Every requested time point occurs within supplied group or subject scope and grain.
time_coverage.evidence_contract: Bound profile claims with provenance, inspection completeness and scope. Missing evidence is unknown.

paired_temporal_support.definition: At least two shared time points have observations for every requested group.
paired_temporal_support.evidence_contract: Bound profile claims with provenance, inspection completeness and scope. Missing evidence is unknown.

complete_requested_grid.definition: Every requested group-time cell is represented.
complete_requested_grid.evidence_contract: Bound profile claims with provenance, inspection completeness and scope. Missing evidence is unknown.

usable_numeric_observations.definition: Required observations have finite usable numeric values, without unresolved conflicting duplicates.
usable_numeric_observations.evidence_contract: Bound profile claims with provenance, inspection completeness and scope. Missing evidence is unknown.

comparable_measure_definition.definition: Units, measure definitions and applicable population/denominator definitions are documented as compatible across compared observations.
comparable_measure_definition.evidence_contract: Bound profile claims with provenance, inspection completeness and scope. Missing evidence is unknown.

constraints: Shared bindings must be consistent across requirements.
Complete-grid activation requires derive_explicit_group_time_grid_v1 with all activation conditions supported, including exhaustive coverage scoped to every requested group.
Time points require a declared time grain.
No silent transformations, invented roles, thresholds or AB IDs.
Between X and Y remains ambiguous between endpoints and an interval unless context resolves it; never infer cadence silently.

provenance.authoring_basis: Design proposal in current conversation; not extracted verbatim from a published taxonomy.

inputs.time_domain: Resolved finite time points/domain and provenance.
inputs.coverage_scope: Reviewed relation of exhaustive coverage to all requested groups.

conditions.groups: At least two distinct requested groups are resolved with source evidence.
conditions.time_domain: A finite temporal domain is resolved with explicit endpoint/inclusion semantics; preserve unresolved range readings.
conditions.time_grain: The requested temporal granularity is explicit, not inferred from a range or bare year labels.
conditions.exhaustive_coverage: The request explicitly requires every temporal position in that domain at that granularity.
conditions.all_groups_scope: The exhaustive temporal requirement unambiguously applies to every requested group under the same action and temporal domain.

provenance.evidence_refs: Map every activation condition to one or more exact-input evidence IDs; overlapping spans are allowed. Record the source input, action instance, literal coverage expression, resolved bindings, and manual scope review in the example card.

derive_explicit_group_time_grid_v1.on_unresolved: Do not derive complete_grid or activate its template. Preserve ambiguity/missing roles; the system default does not repair unresolved required bindings.
limitations: Declarative research proposal; no executable natural-language grounding is implemented.
Every year alone supplies neither groups, finite domain, nor all-groups scope.
Annual or a date range alone is not exhaustive coverage.
Matching spans and reviewed-condition annotations do not prove semantic entailment.
This is not an AB-M1 interpreter normalization or a table-satisfaction claim.

default_available_observations_v1.activation: Default in this proposal when no supported explicit coverage policy is derived; never evidence of user intent and never a remedy for unresolved bindings.
